decision_rule: Preregistered in wiki/plans/2026-11-02-geva-195-r2-rerun-amendment (sections 4 to 7). Two passes each of gstack-full (gstack 5209e92 /review on Opus 5.5, told to run the Review Army and the adversarial pass) and none-rr (Opus 5.5, no gstack, the same told template) on all 33 stacks-r1 units, on #141's driver at 176fdc7, judged blind in one matching and one adjudication batch at rig 715f837. Each blocking blocker's value is the share of an arm's passes that FOUND it; PR clusters are the units. The comparison is scored after noloss derive --drop-gaps on its two arms. No outcome, FIX-METHOD to the Captain with the counts, when gstack-full's exposure gate failed, more than 6 of an arm's 66 sessions ended in turn_cap or allowance_stop, --drop-gaps dropped more than 3 of the 33 units, an arm stopped, or the scorer gave no verdict, delta or interval. Otherwise CUT-CANDIDATE when gstack-full found no more blocking blocker-passes than none-rr; KEEP when the scorer's 95% interval of the recall difference is above zero (a Holm family of one); FIX-METHOD otherwise. The scorer's NO_LOSS, LOSS and size-rule lines are printed but decide nothing. The rescue and complete-case sensitivities, the cohort14 and out19 strata, false blockers per PR on the 6 over-blocking units and every unmatched blocking finding are reported beside.
